objective: Giải thích và thực hiện written calculation methods cơ số 10 cho multi-digit whole numbers và terminating decimals bằng place-value decomposition, regrouping, distributivity, quotient/remainder invariants và tracked powers of ten.

external_curriculum_mappings.phase: Years 3-6 written methods and upper-primary decimal calculations
Number whole-number and decimal calculation progression

misconceptions_or_representation_notes: A written layout is justified by place value; it is not magic symbol manipulation.
Decimal points are aligned for addition/subtraction because equal place values are combined, not because all decimal algorithms use the same alignment rule.
Multiplication/division decimal placement follows powers-of-ten scaling; exact division need not terminate.
change_reason: Added explicit terminating-decimal written-method closure; prior record covered whole-number algorithms only.
